settings.subheading: Bedding and sleepwear, done right. Engineered for better sleep.

settings.heading: How {AppName} was created to redefine sleep
settings.body: Most comforters make you choose: too hot or too cold, too heavy or too light, impossible to wash or just plain uncomfortable.
settings.image_left_alt: Woman smiling while resting on {AppName} pillows

settings.title: Engineered for every sleeper
settings.body: Dual-sided fabrics, adaptive fills and ergonomic shapes so hot sleepers, cold sleepers and side sleepers all get their best night.

settings.title: Washable by design
settings.body: Everything we make survives the washing machine and comes out fluffy. Bedding should be easy to love and easy to clean.

settings.title: Tested by 124,952+ sleepers
settings.body: We iterate on real feedback, from award-winning pillows to the comforter that started it all.

settings.heading: Ready to sleep {AppName}?
settings.body: Try any product for 30 nights. If you do not sleep better, returns are on us.
